GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (13 Aug 46) GA
(SCAPIN-1128)
APO 500
13 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Netherlands East Indies Subjects Now in Japan.
1. It is desired that the Imperial Japanese Government conduct a survey and furnish to this headquarters not later than 4 September 1946 nominal rolls of all Netherlands East Indies subjects now in Japan.
2. Rolls will be submitted in duplicate in form indicated by attached sheets.
3. As indicated by attached sheets separate rolls will be submitted for the following categories of personnel:
a. Those subjects who desire repatriation to the Netherlands East Indies.
b. Those subjects who do not desire repatriation to the Netherlands East Indies.
4. Information to be furnished will be ground alphabetically by prefectures and by families within prefectures.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
